part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `ShapeField.resolveTriangleType` (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/document/ShapeField.java:495): when a flat triangle degenerates to a line segment, the retained segment's "edge belongs to the polygon" flag was taken from the collapsed edge `ab` instead of being merged from the non-collapsed edges. Now each collapse case merges the flags of the edges that make up the retained segment (e.g., `a==b` → new `ab = bc || ca`), so the CONTAINS query correctly detects intersection with an outer polygon edge instead of falsely deducing containment from an "unclosed" polygon.
